  - id: FR_TURNOVER_01
    category: 0
    type: 0
    speaker: First Responder
    text: The house is secured, and access has been controlled since we arrived. John was found on the floor inside with what appears to be a stab wound. We are treating this as a suspected violent death, and the scene remains cordoned off.
    duration: 18
    priority: 1
    skippable: 1
    replaceBehavior: 0
    notes: FR to IOC turnover line 1/4. Preliminary information only; no forensic interpretation.
  - id: FR_TURNOVER_02
    category: 0
    type: 0
    speaker: First Responder
    text: The reporting witness is the nearby vendor. According to the preliminary information we gathered, John was drinking here earlier with his brother Paul and a friend named Peter. The vendor reports seeing Peter leave around two in the morning. He later found John inside and called us.
    duration: 18
    priority: 1
    skippable: 1
    replaceBehavior: 0
    notes: FR to IOC turnover line 2/4. Preliminary information only; no forensic interpretation.
  - id: FR_TURNOVER_03
    category: 0
    type: 0
    speaker: First Responder
    text: We have completed the initial response and preserved the scene for your assessment. We have not carried out forensic processing, and I did not witness the attack. The account of the drinking session and Peter leaving is preliminary information; it still needs to be checked.

    priority: 1
    skippable: 1
    replaceBehavior: 0
    notes: FR to IOC turnover line 3/4. Preliminary information only; no forensic interpretation.
  - id: FR_TURNOVER_04
    category: 0
    type: 0
    speaker: First Responder
    text: I am formally turning over the crime scene and the preliminary information to you as the investigator on case. Here is the completed CSI Form 1, the First Responder's Report, for your case records. You now have responsibility for the scene. We will maintain the cordon and assist you as needed.

    priority: 1
